themes.name: Renal function
themes.interpretation: Pretreatment laboratory measurement of kidney function, represented here by serum creatinine.
themes.disagreements: Main-effect selection was observed for both treatment and outcome prediction, but evidence concerning treatment-effect heterogeneity was mixed: unadjusted log-odds interaction screens showed some signal, while the univariable R-learner showed no positive validation gain and the other heterogeneity methods showed limited or inconsistent support.

themes.name: Pulmonary structural disease
themes.interpretation: Pretreatment imaging evidence of emphysematous lung disease.
themes.disagreements: The evaluated heterogeneity methods were broadly supportive, although nominal univariable interaction results were not positive in every split. Treatment main-effect evidence was unavailable and therefore does not provide negative evidence, while outcome main-effect selection was observed in only part of the evaluated splits.
